faq.subtitle: If you do not find your answer here — just write to us. We respond within 48 hours.

items.q: Do I need any technical knowledge to work with you?
items.a: Not at all. Our job is to handle all the technical complexity so you do not have to. We ask you a few questions about your business processes, you provide access to your tools — and we do the rest. Everything is explained clearly in writing.

items.q: How does the process work if we never have a call?
items.a: We work entirely in writing — email, WhatsApp or Telegram. You fill in a short brief, we send you a proposal within 24 hours. After you approve and pay the deposit, we start work. We deliver via a short Loom screen recording so you can see exactly how everything works — no live meeting required. We find this saves everyone time and creates a clear paper trail.

items.q: What tools do I need to have before we start?
items.a: It depends on the service. For simple integrations — usually just a Google account. For Vipps + Fiken automation you need an active Vipps Business account and a Fiken subscription. For CRM setup we help you choose and register the right system. We always check what you already have before quoting — nothing is assumed and nothing is hidden.

items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.a: Simple integrations: 3–5 business days. Vipps + Fiken automation: 5–7 business days. AI chatbot or CRM setup: 5–10 business days. Landing page + lead flow: 5–10 business days. The timeline starts from the moment we receive your deposit and all required access credentials. Delays on the client side extend the timeline proportionally.

We work with a 50/50 payment structure: 50% deposit before we start, 50% upon delivery. Payment is accepted via Vipps or bank transfer. We issue a formal invoice (faktura) for every transaction. The deposit is non-refundable if the client cancels after work has begun. If we are unable to deliver — we refund 100% of all payments made.

items.q: Do the prices on the site include VAT?
items.a: No. All prices shown are exclusive of VAT (eks. MVA). 25% Norwegian VAT will be added to the invoice once Kasta Flow Studio is registered in the MVA-register, which happens when our annual turnover exceeds 50 000 NOK. Until then — no VAT is added. This will always be stated clearly on your invoice.

items.q: What happens if something stops working after delivery?
items.a: We provide a 30-day free bug fix period after every delivery. If something breaks due to our implementation — we fix it at no charge. Issues caused by third-party API changes or by client-side actions are handled under a support plan or quoted separately. This is why we recommend subscribing to monthly support — it gives you peace of mind for the long term.

items.q: Can you work with tools that are not listed on your site?
items.a: Yes. Our listed services cover the most common use cases, but we regularly work with tools not on the list. If a service has an open API — we can almost certainly integrate it. Use the audit form at the bottom of this page to describe your tools and needs, and we will tell you what is possible.
